subject: Future falsifiers of minimal architecture

subject: Minimum decision/provenance contract (14 responsibilities)
statement: §37 defines a 14-item minimum contract: Decision Subject, decision/as-of time, Reconciled State/Evidence, governed machinery, Policy identity/version, normalized Alternatives, Counterfactual Consequences, admissibility/ordering, Recommendation, no-Recommendation state, effective-time provenance, amendment provenance, operator disposition, Action/Execution/Outcome linkage.
